scope: All canonical tables used by the network; supporting My Info tables; nested PIA and external AIA source shapes; browser graph projection. Field names/types/keys only, never external AIA record values.

tables.label: institution registry
tables.note: Schedule I institution authority and publication metadata.

tables.label: institution personal information banks
tables.note: Registry-keyed PIBs. Specific information types are conservative source-language derivations from explicit description lists. Standard personal-information categories are conceptual, multi-label derivations from descriptions and those specific types.

tables.label: pib cor links
tables.note: Normalized many-to-many links parsed from PIB related-record fields.

tables.label: personal information categories
tables.note: Official controlled vocabulary. My Info assignments are explicitly marked as derived from narrative evidence rather than authoritative source assignments.

tables.label: my info pib features
tables.note: Compact, source-scoped derived features for the My Info questionnaire. Full matching evidence is retained in the adjacent JSONL artifact.

tables.label: my info pib category assignments
tables.note: Derived, evidence-backed many-to-many assignments from PIB records to the official category vocabulary.

tables.label: PIA collection manifest
tables.note: Collection-level schema, counts and provenance, not a record entity.

tables.label: AIA source records
tables.note: External JSONL; schema only is stored here. No AIA values are copied into this repository.

tables.label: AIA survey answers
tables.note: External JSONL; schema only is stored here. No AIA values are copied into this repository.

tables.label: AIA translated answers
tables.note: External JSONL; schema only is stored here. No AIA values are copied into this repository.

tables.label: AIA calculated results
tables.note: External JSONL; schema only is stored here. No AIA values are copied into this repository.

tables.label: AIA normalized identities and citations
tables.note: Normalized organization status, organization-scoped official name_en/name_fr/u_id and literal citation groups. Schema only; no AIA values are stored.
